subject: Oceanography
title: Carbon Dioxide Removal
description: A quick, practical guide to Carbon Dioxide Removal.

hook.text: Could the ocean help remove excess CO₂ from the atmosphere? Several bold ideas are being tested.

buildup.text: Ocean alkalinity enhancement adds minerals to seawater—boosting its ability to absorb and store CO₂.

discovery.text: Artificial upwelling brings nutrients to the surface—stimulating phytoplankton growth that captures carbon.

twist.text: Past iron fertilization experiments had mixed results—some carbon sank deep, but side effects raised concerns.

climax.text: The scale needed is enormous—and unintended ecological consequences could outweigh the benefits.

punchline.text: The ocean might help fix the climate—if we're careful enough.

quiz.question: What is ocean alkalinity enhancement?
options: Adding minerals to seawater to boost CO₂ absorption
